entry_uuid.description: Log entry UUID or opaque identifier, if available.

log_index.description: Numeric log index, if the log exposes one.

leaf_hash.description: Hash of the leaf/entry as logged, if available.

tree_size.description: Tree size at the checkpoint/tree-head referenced by proofs, if available.

inclusion_proof.description: Opaque inclusion proof blob (format depends on log).

consistency_proof.description: Opaque consistency proof between two checkpoints (optional).

checkpoint.description: Opaque signed checkpoint/root/tree-head (format depends on log).

integrated_time.description: Optional time reported by the log for integration.

witness_cosignatures.description: Optional witness cosignatures over a checkpoint/tree-head (split-view defense).

service_receipt.description: Optional opaque receipt returned by a transparency service (e.g. SCITT COSE receipt).
